items.headline: Bernstein initiates GE Vernova coverage with Outperform rating and $1,206 price target; Jefferies raises target to $1,210 and Raymond James starts at Market Perform

Reuters: GE Vernova raises 2026 revenue and margin projections as AI-driven data center and grid demand boosts power equipment orders; wind division faces ~$250M revenue hit from Massachusetts offshore delays

YouTube/financial media: GE Vernova doubles dividend, expands share buyback authorization, and boosts long-term earnings and margin outlook at investor day, citing soaring electricity demand from data centers
